description: Disambiguate city names into Marketplace hubs — id + lat/lng. Flat 2 credits. Costs 2 credits. Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

cache.description: Set true to serve from the 24h response cache (0 credits on hit). Default false — always fetch fresh. Envelope includes cached + cachedAt on hits.

limit.description: Max items to return (default 10, max 50). Flat 2 credits per call.

q.description: City/place query. Bare names like 'Austin' may return multiple candidates (TX/MN/IN); include a state for a single hit (e.g. 'Austin, TX').

name: facebook_marketplace_location_search
title: Facebook Marketplace Location Search
